title: Journalist threatened with arrest at the ESA sergeants' school over Varginha case
place_text: Escola de Sargentos das Armas (ESA), Três Corações, Brazil

tellings.quote: We were investigating the case at the ESA headquarters, the Sergeant School of Arms, and I had never been arrested for doing my job, neither before nor after this case.

plain: A Brazilian journalist says that in 1996 he was threatened with arrest while investigating the Varginha case, a Brazilian affair in which the army is said to have captured a living creature. He says it happened at the army's Sergeants' School of Arms in Três Corações, and that he had "never been arrested for doing my job, neither before nor after this case." The unnamed journalist tells this on the show, and his point is that the military went unusually far to stop reporters asking questions.
